items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: I made the session with Papa, and we went up to WDSU.

ctx.x: I was going to ask some more about some of those sessions, the Celestan session. Do you mind telling us where that was, or do you remember anything about the details of that?

That's how I'm glad you brought that up. Papa Celesty and I were very, very good friends. I like the old man. The old man is very kind. He's very generous, and he's well-liked by everybody. If he needed anybody for benefits, anything, he was right there willing. I went over, after I started my little label, I went up to his house one Sunday afternoon. I says, Papa, you know something? I got everybody who's who in New Orleans but you. I got to have you on my label. He says, son, he says, with a little smile, he…
It's surprising, even ten years, well, not ten years, it was six years since he died, and that's right,
